critique: The black background and warm golden glow are directionally appropriate, but both frames remain a tiny central blob (only a few percent of frame width). At t1 it is nearly circular; at t4 it becomes a small vertical capsule. Neither frame produces the preset thumbnail's large, horizontally extended elliptical magic-disc plane, and the observed motion is localized vertical drift rather than energy distributed across a broad disc.

suggestions.why: Expand the emitter's horizontal extent dramatically so the particle field can occupy a substantial portion of the frame and establish the required wide disc silhouette.
Give the expanded horizontal field a controlled but much smaller vertical thickness, producing an ellipse/disc rather than a point-like mass or tall plume.
Increase horizontal grid sampling so the enlarged emitter reads as a continuous populated energy disc instead of a few merged glowing points.
Remove the emitter velocity responsible for the t4 vertical capsule/drift, keeping particles distributed in a stable horizontal disc plane.
